audit_item: M0.2 / installed-wheel workspace discovery on Linux
finding: Hosted PR CI run 39836917121 failed tests/test_research_access.py::test_registry_path_does_not_depend_on_output_or_cwd on Ubuntu. project_registry() assumed Path(__file__).parents[4] was the workspace root. Linux site-packages has lib/pythonX between the virtualenv and site-packages, so this selected the virtualenv directory instead of the checkout and could not locate the workspace marker or registry inventory.
change: The registry locator now searches ancestors of the resolved package file for the pyproject workspace marker rather than assuming a fixed number of parent directories. The regression test models a Linux installed-wheel path under .venv/lib/python3.14/site-packages and changes cwd to a temporary directory before resolving the registry.
